name: indic-if_bench
description: A Hugging Face dataset intended to evaluate language-model capabilities on Indic-language instruction-following and related NLP tasks. It contains prompts and expected outputs across several short-form tasks (classification, short generation, translation) to assess multilingual and cross-lingual model performance on Indic languages. Useful for testing instruction-following fidelity and basic language understanding in low- to mid-resource Indic settings.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face for Indic-language evaluation with limited adoption outside niche groups.
